content: {"paper_id":"W2133442079","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"our approach provides a novel graph structure construction method by introducing multiple-wise edges instead of pairwise edges, and presents an effective scheme to estimate the weights for such multiple-wise edges.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确提出构建图结构并以multiple-wise边替代pairwise边，还估计这些边的权重，属于学习或修正样本间边与亲和矩阵。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"these two contributions are novel for semi-supervised classification.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要将两项贡献定位于半监督分类，方法为graph-based transductive classification，利用邻居与标签信息进行半监督推断。"},{"keyword_id":"image-segmentation","exact_quote":"The experimental results on image segmentation and transductive classification demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed approach.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要说明在image segmentation上进行了实验，将图像像素划分区域作为应用与评估任务。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","reason_zh":"摘要提到图结构构建和按邻居线性预测标签，但未明确使用图拉普拉斯或流形正则项施加几何一致性约束，证据不足。"},{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","reason_zh":"摘要区分multiple-wise edges与pairwise edges，但这是图结构中的边，未说明扩展must-link或cannot-link成对监督关系。"},{"keyword_id":"bayesian-inference","reason_zh":"摘要仅提到二阶内在Gaussian Markov random field框架，未说明先验后验估计或近似贝叶斯推断，证据不足。"}],"input_issues":[]}
